comments: 41132e2c: This block initializes the DGJTEVT routine which handles events.

bd8b71d8: Flag to indicate the start of processing.

b505d0a5: Determine the type of movement event.
4a1527f9: If this is a new admission and DGPMA is not set, quit the process.

4b1dc4d2: Toggle DGONE flag to indicate processing has started.
37371ed1: Call the DIK subroutine to delete records.
3f772026: Call WARD^DGJTUTL to update ward information.
5803c285: Set ward and division based on the current location.
7f38ea2e: Quit if the division is not defined.

64d9cce9: Loop through the 'ADM' cross-reference to delete associated entries.

d34d01a5: Process new or updated records based on the event type.

3950b482: Set DGJTCA to true if an IEN is found.
3bf5d4da: Handle changes when the pre-movement does not match the after-movement for service transfer.
72ee6368: Handle changes when the pre-movement matches the after-movement but the facility does not.
7c9454be: Clean up variables in DISQ routine.
b96e53ef: NEW subroutine for creating new records.
bbcaa8b5: Set DGJT to the latest treatment episode.
003936cf: Get division treatment parameters.
c8b796f1: Set DGJTWD to the corresponding ward location.
80a6c453: Set DGJTSV to the service connected to the ward.
4b7c0a70: Set service variable to 0 if not found and then find the corresponding service in file 393.1.
8c84f29b: Prepare document variables for incomplete records.
062e8940: Set additional document variables based on treatment parameters.
d372d185: Quit if the movement type is 6 or 2.
8823ff76: Check if DGJTCA is already set to avoid duplicate processing.
793f8fdb: File a new entry in file #393.
64db8615: Set status to 'INCOMPLETE'.
e02fe899: If entry creation was successful, prepare to update the entry.
c3b947cc: Update the newly created or identified record with relevant data.
0def0681: Process the DIE instruction to update the record.
73934e3f: Call DISQ to clean up and quit the NEW routine.
c1d07288: In FILE, set ward and division for admissions, transfers, and discharges.
b340475c: Update the record with additional information.
a1061950: Call DISQ to clean up after FILE routine.
b54f525f: End of the FILE routine.

a02f53ea: Set X to the parameter based on DGJY.

a89280cb: Update the treatment date in the record.
